messages:
Olivia: Quick sync on tenant-level backlog handling. We're seeing heavy spikes when reingests run and it blows up audit runs. Thoughts on bounding work and preserving auditability?
Sam: Proposal sketch: maintain per-tenant watermarks + cheap checkpoint records. Instead of replaying whole topic, drain backfill by tenant shard bounded to checkpoint range.
Raj: That reduces blast radius but complicates correctness across invoice windows. We need well-defined invariants: finalized tokens must be immutable; anything after checkpoint is considered mutable until compacted.
Mia: Suggested event schema (for discussion): {tenant_id, token_id, event_ts, provenance_id, status, offset, region}. Store append-only but mark compaction marker per tenant when safe.
Mia: Example compact marker (written atomically): 
  {"tenant_id":"T-42","checkpoint_ts":1710000000,"last_offset":"k-42-0013579","region":"us-west-2","compact_hash":"sha256:deadbeef..."}
Sam: Keep a short replay log (e.g., 30d) that is hot for auditors + a long-term compact ledger that holds aggregates and provenance pointers. Auditors can request provenance pulls which will materialize original events on-demand.
Jordan: UX/SLA: if a backfill changes charges, should we auto-adjust customer invoices? I'd rather surface pending changes in billing console and allow an automated commit window (default 7 days) or manual acceptance. This preserves customer trust and provides time for investigation.
Olivia: Compensations/repairs need to be explicit. Emit COMPENSATE events referencing original provenance_id and include operator reason and idempotency token. That makes audit diffs straightforward.
Raj: Operational notes: checkpoint writes must be idempotent CAS operations against last_offset. Avoid global coordination; shard-local compare-and-swap is enough. Record region and shard in metadata to reason about cross-region reorders.
Mia: Backfill routing: late-arrivals go to a per-tenant backfill queue that uses tenant checkpoint to cap the window. Workers process tenant windows in order; retries produce explicit retry events instead of in-place mutation.
Sam: Metrics to add: per-tenant backlog count, backlog bytes, avg backfill time, compaction lag, % tenants with pending compensations. Also surface audit query latencies and provenance fetch rates.
Jordan: Failure modes: missing checkpoint (new tenant), tombstoned tenant, partially applied compaction. Need an operator playbook: initial replay bootstrap, tombstone detection, and a compaction verify job that scans compact_hashes.
Olivia: Security/compliance: provenance pulls should be gated by an RBAC scope and logged. Also provide a signed proof bundle for audits (compact_hash + replay deltas) to enable tamper-evidence.
DeployBot: ci/billing-pipeline: deploy v0.2.1 => staging :white_check_mark:
Olivia: Next actions: Mia to draft concrete checkpoint CRD + migration path; Sam to build idempotent checkpoint API spike; Raj to enumerate audit queries and edgecases; Jordan to confirm compliance gating. We'll reconvene in two working days. :thumbsup:
